topic: Sorting Out a Parent's Medicare Card at the Service Counter

script.title: AT THE MEDICARE COUNTER
script.scene_zh: 醫保服務櫃檯 · 補辦媽媽的卡
script.story_hook: One card is missing, but help is near.
script.intro_zh: 保險卡遲遲沒寄到，不過櫃檯後頭有援手。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the benefits counter scene. Listen for card and coverage questions.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到醫保服務櫃檯。今天留意關於卡片與給付的提問。
script.outro: That's one card rerouted and two parts explained. Listen again and say it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一張卡重新寄出，兩個部分也講清楚了。再聽一遍，大膽跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: I'm the one with the questions
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length copper-red hair tucked behind one ear, an olive green trench coat, a small tan crossbody bag slung across her chest, and a petite build
script.char_b_description: a calm middle-aged man in his fifties with thinning grey hair combed to one side, a light blue button-down shirt under a charcoal sweater vest, a round name tag, and a tall thin build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the counter for Medicare cards?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈkaʊɾɚ fɚ ˌmɛdəˈkɛɹ kɑɹdz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問這裡是醫保卡的服務櫃檯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is. Are you the applicant herself?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɑɹ ju ði ˈæplɪkənt hɝˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。請問您本人就是申請人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not quite, I'm here for my mother.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt kwaɪt aɪm hɪɹ fɚ maɪ ˈmʌðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 不完全是，我是來幫母親辦事的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's okay. Do you have her paperwork?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts oʊˈkeɪ du ju hæv ɚ ˈpeɪpɚwɜɹk/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。她的文件有帶來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the approval letter, but no card yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ði əˈpruːvəl ˈlɛɾɚ bʌt noʊ kɑɹd jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 有，只有核准函，保險卡還沒拿到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, cards come separately, usually two weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ kɑɹdz kʌm ˈsɛpəɹətli ˈjuʒəwəli tu wiːkz/
dialogue.zh: 啊，卡片會另外寄，通常約兩週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're at five weeks, um, that feels long.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪɹ æt ˈfaɪv ˈwiːkz ʌm ðæt ˈfilz ˈlɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我們已經等五週了，嗯，感覺有點久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does. Let's start with her full name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz ˈlɛts ˈstɑɹt wɪð ɚ ˈfʊl ˈneɪm/
dialogue.zh: 是夠久了。我們先從她的全名開始查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's Linda May Chen, spelled C-H-E-N.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈlɪndə meɪ tʃɛn spɛld ˈsi eɪtʃ i ɛn/
dialogue.zh: 她叫 Linda May Chen，陳拼作 C-H-E-N。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. And her date of birth?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɑɾ ɪt ænd ɚ ˈdeɪt əv ˈbɝθ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。她的出生年月日是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: June fourth, nineteen fifty-two, easy to remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒun fɔɹθ ˌnɪnˈtin ˈfɪfti tu ˈizi tə rɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 六月四日，一九五二年，很好記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect... I see her file, application approved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪ si ɚ faɪl ˌæpləˈkeɪʃən əˈpruvd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了……我看到她的檔案了，審核已核准。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So why is there no card in our mailbox?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ waɪ ɪz ðɛɹ noʊ kɑɹd ɪn ɑɹ ˈmeɪlbɑks/
dialogue.zh: 那為什麼我們的信箱裡沒有卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, look here, it was sent to the old address.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm lʊk hɪɹ ɪt wəz sɛnt tə ði oʊld əˈdrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，你看這裡，卡片寄到舊地址去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, we moved in March, that's my fault.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈnoʊ wi ˈmuvd ɪn ˈmɑɹtʃ ðæts maɪ ˈfɔlt/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，我們三月搬家，都是我的疏失。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Common slip, happens to half my applicants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmən slɪp ˈhæpənz tə hæf maɪ ˈæplɪkənts/
dialogue.zh: 這很常見，我這裡一半的申請人都會這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you reroute it, or start a new one?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ˈriːraʊt ɪt ɔɹ stɑɹt ə nu wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 你們能改寄嗎？還是重新辦一張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check... yep, I can flag the change.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛt mi ˈtʃɛk jɛp aɪ kæn ˈflæɡ ðə ˈtʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下……可以，我能標記地址更新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Does she need to do anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju dʌz ʃi nid tə du ˈɛniθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。她本人還要做什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just watch the mail for ten days.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈdʒʌst ˈwɑtʃ ðə ˈmeɪl fɚ ˈtɛn ˈdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 不用，只要留意接下來十天的郵件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten days, got it. Um, while I'm here...
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛn ˈdeɪz ˈɡɑɾ ɪt ʌm ˈwaɪl aɪm ˈhɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 十天，記下了。嗯，既然都來了……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what's on your mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɹ ˈwɑts ɑn jɔɹ ˈmaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 當然，你想問什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her letter mentions Part A and Part B.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɚ ˈlɛɾɚ ˈmɛnʃənz pɑɹt ə ænd pɑɹt bi/
dialogue.zh: 她的核准信裡提到 A 部分與 B 部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. Part A covers the hospital stays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ θɪŋ pɑɹt ə ˈkʌvɚz ðə ˈhɑspɪɾəl steɪz/
dialogue.zh: 問得好。A 部分涵蓋住院。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And Part B? The paper was fuzzy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd pɑɹt bi ðə ˈpeɪpɚ wəz ˈfʌzi/
dialogue.zh: 那 B 部分呢？文件上寫得迷迷糊糊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's doctors, check-ups, and shots at clinics.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈdɑktɚz ˈtʃɛk ʌps ænd ʃɑts æt ˈklɪnɪks/
dialogue.zh: B 涵蓋看診、健檢，還有診所施打疫苗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, so both pieces fit together, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ soʊ boʊθ ˈpisɪz fɪt təˈɡɛðɚ hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，原來兩塊是互相搭配的唷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, A for staying, B for visiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli eɪ fɚ ˈsteɪɪŋ bi fɚ ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，住院靠 A，看門診靠 B。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That trick really helped, I'll tell her that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt trɪk ˈɹɪli hɛlpt aɪl tɛl hɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 這個記憶訣竅真好用，我要講給我媽媽聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, she'll love the memory trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du ʃil lʌv ðə ˈmɛməɹi trɪk/
dialogue.zh: 請務必，她會喜歡這個記憶小訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the new card show her number too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə nu kɑɹd ʃoʊ ɚ ˈnʌmbɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 新卡上也會有她的保險編號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will, plus her coverage start date.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl plʌs ɚ ˈkʌvɚɪdʒ stɑɹt deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 會，還會標上給付起算日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does coverage start, did you see?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn dʌz ˈkʌvɚɪdʒ stɑɹt dɪd ju si/
dialogue.zh: 你有看到給付從哪天開始算嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: July first, and claims before that count too.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʊˈlaɪ fɝst ænd kleɪmz bɪˈfɔɹ ðæt kaʊnt tu/
dialogue.zh: 七月一日，而且之前的醫療申請也能補計。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, her knee surgery was in June.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd ɚ ni ˈsɝdʒəɹi wəz ɪn dʒun/
dialogue.zh: 噢太好，她六月中過膝蓋手術。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect timing, that bill can be filed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ ðæt bɪl kæn bi faɪld/
dialogue.zh: 時間剛剛好，那張帳單可以送審。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, she prefers speaking Chinese.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ ʃi pɹɪˈfɝz ˈspikɪŋ tʃaɪˈniz/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，媽講中文比較順。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, easy fix, see the card's back side?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈizi fɪks si ðə kɑɹdz bæk saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 噢，很好解決，卡的背面你看過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh-huh, is there a language line number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌhˌʌh ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ laɪn ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，上面有中文語線的電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, toll-free number, plus Mandarin is listed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˈtoʊl fri ˈnʌmbɚ plʌz ˈmændəˌɹɪn ɪz ˈlɪstɪd/
dialogue.zh: 有，免付費專線，還列了國語服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I'm the one with the questions today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪm ði wʌn wɪð ðə ˈkwɛstʃənz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，今天問個不停的人就是我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good questions beat surprise bills, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈkwɛstʃənz bit sɚˈpɹaɪz bɪlz tɹʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 多問清楚，勝過帳單跳出來嚇人，信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair point. Does the card work at any clinic?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ pɔɪnt dʌz ðə kɑɹd wɝk æt ˈɛni ˈklɪnɪk/
dialogue.zh: 說得也是。這張卡在任何診所都通用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most places, some need a plan check first.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpleɪsɪz sʌm nid ə plæn tʃɛk fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 多數地方收，少數要先核對計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her eye doctor, would that count as covered?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ aɪ ˈdɑktɚ wʊd ðæt kaʊnt æz ˈkʌvɚd/
dialogue.zh: 那她看眼科，會納入給付範圍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just glasses? No, but eye surgery counts.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈɡlæsəz noʊ bʌt aɪ ˈsɝdʒəɹi kaʊnts/
dialogue.zh: 只是配眼鏡？不收，但眼科手術算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, she'll want her glasses paid another way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd ʃil wɑnt ɚ ˈɡlæsəz peɪd əˈnʌðɚ weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，她的眼鏡就用別的方式付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, worth knowing before the frames are bought.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wɝθ ˈnoʊɪŋ bɪˈfɔɹ ðə fɹeɪmz ɑɹ bɔt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，買鏡框前先知道這件事很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, anything I should sign today?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ aɪ ʃʊd saɪn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，今天有什麼需要我簽的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just this address update form, two lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðɪs əˈdrɛs ˈʌpˌdeɪt fɔɹm tu laɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 就這張地址更新單，簽兩處就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signed. Do I get a copy for myself?
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪnd du aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈkɑpi fɚ maɪˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 簽好了。我能留一份副本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, stamped and dated already.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ju ɡoʊ stæmpt ænd ˈdeɪtɪd ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 給你，已經蓋章註明日期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've been a huge help, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /juv bɪn ə hjuːdʒ hɛlp ˈtɹuli/
dialogue.zh: 你真的幫了我們很大的忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure. Anything else on the list?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʒɚ ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls ɑn ðə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。清單上還有事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope, um, that's everything. Thank you kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp ʌm ðæts ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ θæŋk ju ˈkaɪndli/
dialogue.zh: 沒有了，嗯，這樣就齊全了，多謝您。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell your mother the card is on its way.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl jɔɹ ˈmʌðɚ ðə kɑɹd ɪz ɑn ɪts weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 請轉告媽媽，卡片已經上路了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Should I call if ten days pass?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwɪl ˈʃʊd aɪ ˈkɔl ɪf ˈtɛn ˈdeɪz ˈpæs/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。要是十天還沒收到，再打來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call this office, ask for me, Ben.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ðɪs ˈɔfəs æsk fɚ mi bɛn/
dialogue.zh: 打這間辦公室，找我本恩就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben at the Medicare counter, got it.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛn æt ðə ˌmɛdəˈkɛɹ ˈkaʊntɚ ɡɑɾ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 醫保櫃檯的本恩，記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a good one, both of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæv ə ˈɡʊd ˈwʌn ˈboʊθ əv ju/
dialogue.zh: 祝你跟媽媽今天都順心。

script.youtube_title: 【幫媽媽辦醫保🪪】「今天問個不停的人是我」💳保險卡沒寄到怎麼辦🏥｜改地址・分A與B・語線電話✍️｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Medicare Card Help
script.youtube_title_en: "I'm the One with the Questions" — Sorting Out a Parent's Medicare Card
script.youtube_description:
「今天問個不停的人就是我」——媽媽的醫保卡遲遲沒寄到，你帶著核准函來到服務櫃檯，一場從補卡到聽懂給付說明的實地演練就此展開。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在醫保服務中心的櫃檯前。

你會聽到：說明「我是替母親辦事」的開場句；查案名、核對生日的流程問答；發現卡片寄到舊地址時怎麼改寄、怎麼承認是自己的疏失；A 部分與 B 部分怎麼用一句話分清；還有中文語線電話、給付起算日、眼科手術收不收這些細節追問。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人辦事務時的真實語感：um、well、hmm、yep、uh-huh。聽完你就會用：Do you have her paperwork?、Can you reroute it?、When does coverage start?、That's my fault。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"I'm the one with the questions today" — Mom's Medicare card never arrived, so you show up at the service counter with an approval letter and a list of doubts. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at a benefits service counter.

You will hear: opening lines for 'I'm here for my mother'; giving a full name, spelling, and birth date; the awkward moment when a card was mailed to an old address; flagging the change and asking if anything needs signing; plus a one-sentence way to remember Part A and Part B, a language helpline on the card, and coverage start dates.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real counter small talk: um, well, hmm, yep, uh-huh. By the end you'll own phrases like Do you have her paperwork?, Can you reroute it?, and When does coverage start?

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
幫媽媽處理醫保卡，卡卻沒寄到，你坐在櫃檯前，一疊文件、一腦子問題，該從哪裡問起？A 部分和 B 部分到底差在哪？中文語線要上哪找？

這一集帶大家走進醫保服務中心的櫃檯，從說明替母親辦事、核對姓名生日，一路聽到改地址重寄、理解給付範圍與起算日、語線電話與臨行道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🪪 開場句：Not quite, I'm here for my mother.
🏠 找出問題：Hmm, look here, it was sent to the old address.
🩺 分清給付：Exactly, A for staying, B for visiting.
📞 語線服務：Yep, toll-free number, plus Mandarin is listed.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、hmm、uh-huh、well 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著跑完這一趟櫃檯，下次替家人辦事，英文自己會開口。

願媽媽的新卡這週就躺在她的信箱裡。
